title: Fusion discoveries: measured organ behavior and unexpected quirks
question: How do Word Math and Connected Systems First interact with already-connected Lab organs, and which interactions expose hidden downstream effects rather than duplicate wiring?
summary: A complete corrected seven-probe synthetic fusion run was published from an authenticated Termux GitHub session for private Lab master a08c9619ba60. All seven records reported OBSERVED. The latest raw, bounded observations are in latest_results.json; downstream benefits are NOT independently evaluated or proven. Earlier findings remain in FINDINGS.md.
